n34d3d513894.s: GSAT-7A, nicknamed 'Angry Bird', mainly serves which service?
n34d3d513894.x: GSAT-7A serves the Indian Air Force and supports network-centric warfare and drone operations.

nd77f88f8778.s: EMISAT, a DRDO satellite launched by PSLV-C45 in 2019, is used for:
nd77f88f8778.x: EMISAT is a DRDO satellite that performs electronic intelligence (ELINT); it was launched by PSLV-C45 in 2019.

n78cdb5e7d26.s: The PSLV-C62/EOS-N1 mission failed because of:
o: A pressure drop in the third-stage solid motor
A roll-rate disturbance at the end of the third stage
Premature shutdown of the fourth-stage engine
n78cdb5e7d26.x: PSLV-C62/EOS-N1 failed after a roll-rate disturbance at the end of the third stage; the pressure-drop failure was associated with EOS-09 on PSLV-C61.

nd064800d74f.s: EOS-05, India's first earth-imaging satellite meant for geosynchronous orbit, will operate at an altitude of about:
nd064800d74f.x: EOS-05 is intended for geosynchronous orbit at about 36,000 km, supporting observation of floods, cyclones, fires and security events.

n58cff0e53b6.s: GSAT-3, India's first satellite dedicated to education, is popularly known as:
n58cff0e53b6.x: GSAT-3, popularly known as EDUSAT, was India's first satellite dedicated to education and provided two-way satellite communication to classrooms.

naf6e0bdd5cd.s: EDUSAT was launched on 20 September 2004 by:
naf6e0bdd5cd.x: EDUSAT was launched on 20 September 2004 by GSLV-F01 from Sriharikota.

ndc067ac9067.s: AzaadiSAT, built by 750 girl students of government schools with Space Kidz India, was launched in August 2022 on:
ndc067ac9067.x: AzaadiSAT was launched on SSLV-D1 in August 2022 but failed to reach orbit.

nedbded2d2c3.s: The StudSat consortium included colleges from which State, when it was undivided?
nedbded2d2c3.x: The StudSat consortium included colleges from Andhra Pradesh, when the State was undivided.

n2cca69c7411.s: IN-SPACe, chaired by Dr Pawan Kumar Goenka, is headquartered at:
n2cca69c7411.x: IN-SPACe is headquartered at Ahmedabad, and Dr Pawan Kumar Goenka is its chairman.

na4a67cca72c.s: LVM3's first dedicated commercial mission in 2022 carried how many OneWeb satellites?
na4a67cca72c.x: LVM3's first dedicated commercial mission, in 2022, carried 36 OneWeb satellites.

n01339069ec7.s: TSAT-1A, a sub-metre optical surveillance satellite launched on a SpaceX Falcon 9 in 2024, was built by Tata Advanced Systems with:
n01339069ec7.x: TSAT-1A was built by Tata Advanced Systems with Satellogic and launched on a SpaceX Falcon 9 in 2024.

n4ff60a04abf.s: Vikram-1 carried the SOLARAS nanosatellite, built with Grahaa Space, bearing the VISWA-M payload of:
n4ff60a04abf.x: Vikram-1 carried the SOLARAS nanosatellite with VIT-AP University's VISWA-M solar-spectrum payload, built with Grahaa Space.

n4178ba32b1e.s: The public-private Earth-observation constellation approved by IN-SPACe is led by:
n4178ba32b1e.x: IN-SPACe approved a PPP Earth-observation constellation led by Pixxel, with Dhruva Space, SatSure Analytics India and Piersight Space as partners.

n2e1a0453ec0.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Azista Space Industries – Drishti multi-sensor Earth-imaging satellite
Ananth Technologies – First private satellite integration facility in India
Digantara – First commercial small-satellite launch from Indian soil
n2e1a0453ec0.x: Ananth Technologies set up the first private satellite integration facility; Azista executed the first commercial small-satellite launch from Indian soil, GalaxEye built Drishti and Digantara does space surveillance.

n4b3bb311e09.s: Andhra Pradesh's space-sector initiative includes dedicated space cities and Space Policy:
n4b3bb311e09.x: Andhra Pradesh has announced Space Policy 4.0 and is developing dedicated space cities to promote space manufacturing.

n2dd98561e4d.s: The Indian Space Policy 2023 was approved by the Union Cabinet on:
n2dd98561e4d.x: The Union Cabinet approved the policy on 6 April 2023; the Department of Space released it on 20 April 2023.

nc22c6cecb46.s: PSLV-C62, lost in a launch failure in January 2026, carried how many start-up and academic co-passengers?
nc22c6cecb46.x: PSLV-C62 carried 15 start-up and academic co-passengers, but the mission was lost in a launch failure in January 2026.

n4ea0c630081.s: SAR (microwave) remote sensing is especially useful for flood mapping because it can:
o: Record images only in visible light
Measure thermal emission from water bodies
Observe through cloud cover and in darkness
Operate only in daylight under clear skies
n4ea0c630081.x: Microwave/SAR systems can observe through cloud cover and in darkness, making them useful for flood mapping in cloudy conditions.

n40c36409ef8.s: InSAR detects ground deformation by comparing which property of two or more radar images of the same area?
n40c36409ef8.x: Interferometric SAR compares the phase of two or more radar images of the same area to detect ground deformation.

n9a57e8d6bf1.s: The NH Green Cover Index 2025-26 is India's first satellite-based green-cover assessment of:
n9a57e8d6bf1.x: The NH Green Cover Index is India's first satellite-based green-cover assessment of highways and uses chlorophyll detection.

n404a7c63a45.s: Bhuvan combines RISAT/SAR imagery and INSAT-3DS cyclone-track data mainly to provide:
n404a7c63a45.x: Bhuvan combines RISAT/SAR flood imagery and INSAT-3DS cyclone-track information to support flood-inundation mapping and cyclone warnings.

n02f29099f21.s: Which type of sensor is best suited for measuring soil moisture from space?
n02f29099f21.x: Microwave and SAR sensors are particularly suitable for soil-moisture measurement; NISAR uses L-band and S-band radar for this.

n0877dc097a4.s: Resourcesat-series data are mainly used for:
o: Crop acreage assessment, watershed management and precision farming
n0877dc097a4.x: Resourcesat data support crop acreage assessment, watershed management and precision farming.

nfd6d8fd2558.s: In GIS, overlay analysis refers to:
o: Converting raster data into vector data
Creating a buffer zone around a feature
Combining different data layers for analysis
nfd6d8fd2558.x: Overlay analysis combines multiple thematic layers to derive and analyse relationships between them.

n962214f6e1e.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: FASAL – Satellite-based crop yield estimation for PMFBY
CHAMAN – Horticulture area and production assessment
NADAMS – Pre-harvest crop acreage and production forecasts
n962214f6e1e.x: CHAMAN covers horticulture. FASAL gives pre-harvest forecasts, YES-TECH estimates yield for PMFBY and NADAMS monitors agricultural drought.

nb2c84c03787.s: The satellite-based coastal-fishermen alert service run from the RTGS hub at Vijayawada warns about:
o: Cyclones, high waves and fish shoals
nb2c84c03787.x: The RTGS hub at Vijayawada provides satellite-based alerts to coastal fishermen about cyclones, high waves and fish shoals.

nc6baab2e3e2.s: Tele-education, telemedicine and Village Resource Centres in India have been enabled by which satellite systems?
nc6baab2e3e2.x: INSAT and GSAT satellite communication systems have enabled tele-education, telemedicine and Village Resource Centres.

ndd2372da6f5.s: The Andhra Pradesh Motor Vehicle Tracking System (APMVTS) uses AIS-140 devices mainly to track:
ndd2372da6f5.x: APMVTS fitted 50,000 mineral vehicles with AIS-140 tracking devices.

n81a47540108.s:
Consider the following uses of satellite-based timing:
1. Banks use it to time-stamp transactions.
2. Power grids use it to synchronise their phase.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n81a47540108.x: Satellite time is used by banks to time-stamp transactions and by power grids to synchronise their phase.

naa85be2ad62.s: Space debris is best defined as:
o: Operational satellites that have drifted from their assigned orbit
All non-functional man-made objects, including fragments, in orbit or re-entering
Natural meteoroids passing through Earth orbit
Fragments created only by anti-satellite tests
naa85be2ad62.x: Space debris consists of non-functional man-made objects, including fragments, that are in orbit or re-entering the atmosphere.

n9b7921cfb7b.s: Bengaluru-based start-up Digantara works mainly in:
o: Space situational awareness and debris tracking
n9b7921cfb7b.x: Digantara is a space-situational-awareness start-up building space-surveillance satellites and generating debris-tracking data.

n874ab54eb2d.s: ISRO's planned Active Debris Removal mission will capture a defunct rocket body using a servicer craft fitted with:
n874ab54eb2d.x: The planned ADR mission uses a servicer craft with a robotic arm or net to capture a defunct Indian rocket body; it is being tested at URSC.

nd6b4333ce0c.s: Which of the following is identified as a significant legal gap in India's space sector?
o: Absence of a national space policy
Absence of a body to authorise private space activities
Absence of a Space Activities Act addressing liability
nd6b4333ce0c.x: India does not have a Space Activities Act specifically addressing liability, which is identified as a significant legal gap.

n3f7dcfc406e.s: UNCOPUOS, of which India is a founding member, was established in:
n3f7dcfc406e.x: The UN Committee on the Peaceful Uses of Outer Space was established in 1959, and India is a founding member.

n701512689e1.s: The Inter-Agency Space Debris Coordination Committee (IADC), of which ISRO is a member, was established in:
n701512689e1.x: IADC was established in 1993 and ISRO is a member; India made its DFSM-2030 pledge at the 2024 IADC meeting.

nbf979403d75.s: DRDO's current vision is to empower the nation with state-of-the-art indigenous ____ technologies.
nbf979403d75.x: DRDO's current vision is to empower the nation with state-of-the-art indigenous defence and security technologies.

nd5cba30bd56.s: The Technology Development Fund (TDF), a Ministry of Defence programme executed by DRDO, is implemented under:
nd5cba30bd56.x: TDF is a Ministry of Defence flagship programme executed by DRDO under the Make in India initiative.

n9bbbdd81264.s: Which of the following Hyderabad DRDO laboratories is correctly matched with its field?
o: ASL – Metals, alloys and armour materials
n9bbbdd81264.x: DLRL is the electronic-warfare lab. DRDL develops missiles such as MPATGM, ASL handles Agni-class missiles and DMRL works on metals, alloys and armour.

nb182c9fd57a.s: The CBRN Field Training Centre under INMAS, Delhi trains personnel of:
nb182c9fd57a.x: The centre trains personnel of the Ministry of Defence, Ministry of Home Affairs and National Disaster Management Authority in CBRN preparedness.

n04db5dbb391.s: DRDO Industry Academia Centres of Excellence (DIA-CoEs), set up at premier institutions such as IITs and IISc, number:
n04db5dbb391.x: DIA-CoEs are a network of 15 centres at premier institutions working on critical and futuristic defence technologies.

n9c185d9ab12.s: Akash, a medium-range surface-to-air missile, travels at a speed of about:
n9c185d9ab12.x: Akash is a medium-range SAM with a range of about 25-30 km, a speed of about Mach 2.5 and an altitude capability of 18 km.

nbcfa86b6d5f.s: Mission Divyastra (2024) tested MIRV technology on which missile?
nbcfa86b6d5f.x: Mission Divyastra, conducted in 2024, flight-tested Agni-V with Multiple Independently targetable Re-entry Vehicles (MIRVs).

n13e541d7c09.s: In the context of Trishul's replacement, which pair of service and missile system is correctly matched?
n13e541d7c09.x: The Indian Air Force was associated with Israeli Spyder, the Navy with Barak-1 and the Army with Akash.

nf78199a5290.s: HELINA, the helicopter-launched variant of the Nag missile, is meant for:
nf78199a5290.x: HELINA is the helicopter-launched Nag variant for Army Aviation, whereas Dhruvastra is intended for the Indian Air Force.

n0909d88a39a.s: Dr Tessy Thomas, who played a key role in Agni-V, is popularly called:
n0909d88a39a.x: Dr Tessy Thomas, the 'Missile Woman of India', played a key role in Agni-V and is called 'Agniputri'.

n6a5ac3c8b4a.s: In the top-attack mode, an anti-tank missile generally:
o: Approaches at ground level and hits the side armour
Climbs and then dives onto the tank's thinner top armour
Strikes the thick frontal armour head-on
Hits the tracks to immobilise the tank
n6a5ac3c8b4a.x: In top attack, the missile climbs and then dives onto the tank's thinner top armour; Nag has both top-attack and direct-attack modes.

n2f6988aa5ce.s:
Consider the following statements about BrahMos:
1. It was developed jointly by India and Russia.
2. It was one of the missiles of the IGMDP.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n2f6988aa5ce.x: BrahMos was developed jointly by India and Russia; it was not part of the IGMDP, though it is sometimes listed alongside IGMDP missiles.

n01a27baf709.s: A scramjet engine is characterised by:
o: Subsonic combustion after the air is slowed down
Carrying all the oxygen needed for combustion
Supersonic combustion and no rotating parts
n01a27baf709.x: A scramjet uses supersonic combustion and has no rotating compressor or turbine parts; unlike a rocket, it does not carry its oxidiser.

nd92ccdd97c6.s: Astra, developed by DRDO with an active radar seeker, is a family of:
nd92ccdd97c6.x: Astra is a DRDO-developed family of beyond-visual-range air-to-air missiles using an active radar seeker.

n7565d12b82a.s: The Indigenous Technology Cruise Missile (ITCM), successor to Nirbhay, is powered by the:
n7565d12b82a.x: ITCM is the successor to Nirbhay and is powered by the indigenous Manik small turbofan engine developed by GTRE.

n6ae14d61cb7.s:
Consider the following statements about India's HSTDV:
1. It flew at above Mach 6.
2. It validated scramjet combustion and thermal protection above 2,000°C.
3. It is a submarine-launched missile with a range of 3,500 km.
Which of the above statements are correct?
n6ae14d61cb7.x: HSTDV flew at above Mach 6 and validated scramjet combustion and thermal protection above 2,000°C; it is not a submarine-launched missile.

nc630fbef31c.s: Which of the following BMD layer – interceptor pairs is correctly matched?
nc630fbef31c.x: Phase-I uses PAD/Pradyumna (exo) and AAD/Ashwin (endo); Phase-II uses AD-1 (exo) and AD-2 (endo).

n777fd1d84d3.s: In Mission Shakti, the live satellite Microsat-R was destroyed by which DRDO interceptor?
n777fd1d84d3.x: A DRDO PDV Mk-II interceptor destroyed the live satellite Microsat-R during Mission Shakti.

n9924ef5260f.s: Pokhran-I, officially described as a peaceful nuclear explosion, was conducted on:
n9924ef5260f.x: Pokhran-I took place on 18 May 1974 under Prime Minister Indira Gandhi and was described as a peaceful nuclear explosion.

n831403d0b79.s: India's nuclear doctrine retains the nuclear option against a major attack involving:
n831403d0b79.x: The doctrine retains the nuclear option against a major biological or chemical attack.

n9115a31111c.s: The land-based leg of the United States nuclear triad consists of:
n9115a31111c.x: The US triad consists of Minuteman III ICBMs (land leg), strategic bombers and Ohio/Columbia-class SSBNs.

n77914b79376.s: The Advanced Technology Vessel (ATV) project was undertaken to build India's:
n77914b79376.x: The ATV project was initiated by DRDO and private firms, with Russian assistance, to build SSBNs.

na4bc14961cc.s: Which of the following pairs of export-control regime and India's joining year is correctly matched?
na4bc14961cc.x: India joined Wassenaar in 2017; it joined the MTCR (as 35th member) and the Hague Code of Conduct in 2016, and the Australia Group in 2018.

n6774a5a156b.s: In India's BMD programme, PAD (Prithvi Air Defence) is the:
n6774a5a156b.x: PAD is the higher-altitude exo-atmospheric interceptor; AAD is the lower-altitude endo-atmospheric interceptor and Swordfish is a tracking radar.

n44b8ffa0652.s: AD-1 and AD-2 interceptors belong to which phase of India's BMD programme?
n44b8ffa0652.x: AD-1 and AD-2 are Phase II BMD interceptors meant for longer-range threats of about the 5,000-km class.

n9b04c499973.s: The Tejas Light Combat Aircraft, built by HAL, was designed by:
n9b04c499973.x: The Tejas LCA was designed by the Aeronautical Development Agency and built by Hindustan Aeronautics Limited.

nd474d00bb6f.s: Tejas is identified as India's first indigenous:
nd474d00bb6f.x: Tejas is identified as India's first indigenous fly-by-wire aircraft.

n73392efc95c.s: INS Vikrant (IAC-1), India's first indigenous aircraft carrier, was built by:
n73392efc95c.x: INS Vikrant, India's first indigenous aircraft carrier (IAC-1), was built by Cochin Shipyard.

nf00262a9c8d.s: Which submarine is identified as the last boat of Project 75?
nf00262a9c8d.x: Vaghsheer is the last P75 boat. (Surat is the last P15B destroyer, H-561 the first indigenous hovercraft, and INS Tamal was built in Russia.)

na2234dee87c.s: For Project-75(I) AIP-equipped submarines, Navantia of Spain signed a teaming agreement in July 2023 with:
na2234dee87c.x: Project-75(I) concerns next-generation conventional submarines with air-independent propulsion; Navantia and L&T signed a teaming agreement in July 2023.

n4a4039bc3d3.s: Suryastra, a 300 km-range universal rocket launcher, was developed by NIBE with:
n4a4039bc3d3.x: Suryastra is a universal rocket launcher developed by NIBE with Israel, with a stated range of 300 km.

n55cf389cbab.x: LLM-105 is an insensitive high explosive with greater safety against accidental detonation.

n6d0f30988bc.s: Bio-digester-based bio-toilets, developed to treat waste in high-altitude areas, have been adopted by:
n6d0f30988bc.x: Bio-toilets treat waste in high-altitude environments and have been adopted by the Railways.

ne03865d694b.s: DRDO, whose motto is 'Balasya Mulam Vigyanam', was formed in:
ne03865d694b.x: DRDO was formed in 1958 and its motto is 'Balasya Mulam Vigyanam' (the source of strength is science).

o: Low-level lightweight 3D radar detecting cruise missiles and drones
Fire-control radar of the Akash system
nd5de97c8ce8.x: Ashwini is a low-level lightweight 3D radar that detects cruise missiles and drones; Swathi is weapon-locating, Rajendra serves Akash and Swordfish does long-range tracking.

nchemistry-18-11.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nchemistry-18-11.x: RDX is (O₂NNCH₂)₃. TNG is C₃H₅(ONO₂)₃, TNP is (O₂N)₃C₆H₂OH and CL-20 is C₆H₆N₁₂O₁₂.

nchemistry-18-25.s: Amatol is a mixture of TNT and:
nchemistry-18-25.x: Amatol is TNT mixed with ammonium nitrate; it contains no nitroglycerine and is a high explosive, not a propellant.

nae2b791a648.s: Lukoskin, a DRDO product, is a:
nae2b791a648.x: Lukoskin is a polyherbal ointment used for leucoderma, also called vitiligo.

na18d9bf9500.s: The Ministry of Defence declared 2025 as the:
na18d9bf9500.x: The Ministry of Defence declared 2025 the Year of Reforms and began reviewing DAP 2020 to support JVs and technology transfer for the private sector.

nbd1d503ed8d.s:
Consider the following statements about India's defence-export position:
1. India remains outside the top 25 arms exporters.
2. India continues to import jet engines and defence chips.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nbd1d503ed8d.x: Despite record exports, India remains outside the top 25 arms exporters and still imports jet engines and defence chips.

n20599902a6c.s: Under the Defence India Startup Challenge (DISC) of iDEX, the problem statements for start-ups are set by:
n20599902a6c.x: DISC comprises iDEX challenge rounds in which the Services set problem statements for start-ups to solve.

n4cf233ecd10.s: VIMARSH 2026, offering direct funding, incubation, test-facility access and source-code sharing, is aimed at:
n4cf233ecd10.x: VIMARSH 2026 provides direct funding, incubation and test-facility access for MSMEs and start-ups, and includes source-code sharing.

nda928c05632.s: Which of the following Andhra Pradesh defence units is correctly matched with its purpose?
o: BEL Palasamudram – Opto-electronics and night vision
BEL Machilipatnam – Missile and radar systems integration
Rambilli – New Eastern Naval Command base for submarines
Naval Dockyard, Visakhapatnam – Missile and radar systems integration
nda928c05632.x: Rambilli is the new ENC submarine base. BEL Palasamudram integrates missile and radar systems, BEL Machilipatnam makes opto-electronics and the Naval Dockyard is the ENC refit yard.

n010f6c0e770.s: NSTL, Visakhapatnam, DRDO's naval weapons laboratory, is associated with:
o: Torpedoes such as Varunastra, mines and AUVs
n010f6c0e770.x: NSTL is DRDO's naval weapons laboratory, associated with torpedoes such as Varunastra, mines and AUVs.

nd066ae923c7.s:
Consider the following statements about the energy intensity of GDP:
1. It is the energy used per unit of GDP.
2. A rising value shows growth decoupling from energy use.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nd066ae923c7.x: Energy intensity is energy used per unit of GDP; it is a falling, not rising, value that shows growth decoupling from energy use.

nf4160a3c3f6.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Energy shortage refers to unmet energy requirement and is expressed in MU.
2. Peak shortage refers to unmet peak demand and is expressed in MW.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nf4160a3c3f6.x: Energy shortage is unmet energy requirement (MU or %), while peak shortage is unmet peak demand (MW or %).

ndeddc99d113.s: Which of the following report – publisher pairs is correctly matched?
o: India Energy Security Scenarios 2047 – International Energy Agency
Electric Power Survey – Central Electricity Authority
ndeddc99d113.x: The Electric Power Survey is CEA's demand forecast. IESS 2047 is NITI Aayog's, the India Energy Outlook is the IEA's and Energy Statistics is published by CSO, now NSO.

nf7ea6aba52c.s: As per NITI Aayog's India Energy Security Scenarios projection, India's energy demand between 2012 and 2040 was expected to rise by:
nf7ea6aba52c.x: Total energy demand was projected to rise 2.7–3.2 times from 2012 to 2040, while electricity demand would rise 4.5-fold.

n09fd621a080.s: By 2040, which sector is projected to remain the largest consumer of energy in India?
n09fd621a080.x: Industry remains the largest sector, with 8,764 TWh under BAU in 2040, while cooking demand falls as clean fuels replace biomass.

n2785268819f.s: NITI Aayog's 'Scenarios Towards Viksit Bharat and Net Zero' projects renewables' share of power generation rising from about 20% (2024-25) to about ____ by 2070.
n2785268819f.x: The study projects renewables rising from about 20% to about 80% of generation by 2070, with coal falling from about 74% to 6-10%.

n50a3cd9e6eb.s: India's all-time high peak electricity demand recorded in May 2026 was:
n50a3cd9e6eb.x: The May 2026 peak demand was an all-time high of 270.8 GW, about 90 GW above the 2019 level.

n8e1ebba2091.s: Which scheme is associated with electricity connections to about 26 million households?
n8e1ebba2091.x: The Saubhagya programme is associated with connecting approximately 26 million households.

ne6a71b6807c.s: Regional imbalances in renewable electricity in India may arise mainly because of:
ne6a71b6807c.x: Poor storage and slow transmission can strand renewable power in some regions, while heatwaves add stress on grids.

ne70d4068a67.s: The Compressed Biogas Obligation in the City Gas Distribution sector mainly aims to substitute imports of:
ne70d4068a67.x: The CBO is intended to promote compressed biogas and substitute LNG imports.

n3dba691dd27.s: Which of the following pairs of supplier and approximate share of India's crude imports in 2025 is correctly matched?
n3dba691dd27.x: In 2025 Russia supplied about 35% of India's crude imports, Iraq about 20%, Saudi Arabia about 15% and the US about 8%.

na67d4abbd72.s: Of India's 26 sedimentary basins, how many are producing hydrocarbons?
na67d4abbd72.x: India has 26 sedimentary basins, of which only 7 are producing.

n6887e9e022e.s: After the Strait of Hormuz closure in March 2026, India proposed a strategic fuel system of what capacity?
n6887e9e022e.x: The disruption was linked to a 41% jump in the July crude bill, an LPG crunch and a proposed 41 MT strategic fuel system.

nac5438e478a.s: The strategic petroleum reserve at Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, has a capacity of:
nac5438e478a.x: The Visakhapatnam reserve has a stated capacity of 1.33 MMT; Padur (Karnataka) has 2.5 MMT.

n967a7dbf307.s: From FY 2028-29, the Compressed Biogas Obligation is set at what share of CNG-PNG?
n967a7dbf307.x: The obligation is 1% in FY26, 3% in FY27, 4% in FY28 and 5% from FY 2028-29.

nfc66c43d102.s: The Indian Institute of Petroleum and Energy (IIPE), Visakhapatnam, established in 2016, was declared an Institution of National Importance in:
nfc66c43d102.x: IIPE was established in 2016, became an Institution of National Importance in 2017 and signed a shale-modelling pact with OIL India in April 2026.

nf7ac15cb63f.s: Under the Electricity Act, 2003, Renewable Purchase Obligations are fixed by:
o: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
nf7ac15cb63f.x: The Electricity Act 2003 enables State Electricity Regulatory Commissions to fix Renewable Purchase Obligations.

nf4fa825114f.s: Fossil fuels account for nearly what share of India's commercial primary energy supply?
nf4fa825114f.x: Fossil fuels constitute nearly 90% of commercial primary energy supply and are increasingly imported.

n5f0b25ab083.s: In the Constitution, 'Electricity' is placed under:
n5f0b25ab083.x: Electricity is a concurrent subject, placed under Entry 38 of List III.

nfd1e83b2c60.s: Which of the following programme – aim pairs is correctly matched?
o: PM Ujjwala Yojana – Last-mile household electrification
DDUGJY – Rural feeder separation and village electrification
Saubhagya – LPG connections to BPL women
PM Ujjwala Yojana – Rural feeder separation
nfd1e83b2c60.x: DDUGJY is for feeder separation and village electrification; PMUY gives LPG connections to BPL women and Saubhagya covers household electrification.

nccaa6e71768.s: A household with rooftop solar and battery storage that uses part of its power and sells the surplus to the grid is called a:
nccaa6e71768.x: A consumer who also produces or stores electricity is a prosumer; DERs turn consumers into prosumers.

n891a9a46c23.s: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana aims to provide rooftop solar for how many households?
n891a9a46c23.x: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana focuses on rooftop solar for one crore households.

n0cba1083c37.s: Andhra Pradesh's virtual net metering under its distributed energy policy focuses on:
n0cba1083c37.x: Andhra Pradesh has introduced virtual net metering with a focus on SC/ST households.

n146e6e6b00b.s: Under the Renewable Purchase Obligation, which entities must buy a prescribed share of power from renewable sources?
o: DISCOMs and open-access or captive users
n146e6e6b00b.x: RPO requires DISCOMs and open-access or captive users to buy a prescribed share of renewable power; SERCs fix the obligation.

n669976e1d2b.s: The International Energy Agency (IEA), an OECD-affiliated energy policy body, is headquartered at:
n669976e1d2b.x: The IEA is headquartered in Paris; Abu Dhabi hosts IRENA, Vienna hosts OPEC and Gurugram hosts the International Solar Alliance.

naeeed68b0ae.s: India submitted its Long-Term Low Emission Development Strategy to the UNFCCC at:
naeeed68b0ae.x: India submitted its Long-Term Low Emission Development Strategy to the UNFCCC at COP27 in 2022.

n065eef71445.s: India's reported wind-energy target for 2030 is:
n065eef71445.x: The reported wind-energy targets are 100 GW by 2030 and 155 GW by 2035.

nca988d6db96.s: Compared with combustion engines, green-hydrogen fuel cells are generally:
nca988d6db96.x: Green-hydrogen fuel cells are more efficient than combustion engines.

n9bba8c5dc0c.s: Mawlong coalfield, associated with Tertiary coal, is located in:
n9bba8c5dc0c.x: Mawlong is in Meghalaya and is associated with Tertiary coal.

n0e36502a860.s: Which State leads India in lignite resources (estimated at 47.295 billion tonnes)?
n0e36502a860.x: Lignite resources are 47.295 billion tonnes, with Tamil Nadu (Neyveli) leading, followed by Rajasthan and Gujarat.

nd57fcb41bc4.s: Commercial coal blocks get a 50% rebate on revenue share if at least what share of their output goes to gasification?
nd57fcb41bc4.x: Commercial blocks get a 50% rebate on revenue share if at least 10% of their output is used for gasification.

ne75246b88d2.s:
Consider the following statements about the ₹37,500-crore coal gasification scheme:
1. No bidders had turned up for the scheme.
2. Bid windows were planned every two months.
3. The scheme was withdrawn because the mission target had been achieved.
Which of the above statements are correct?
ne75246b88d2.x: No bidders had turned up and bid windows were planned every two months; the scheme was not withdrawn.

n44c6ef8210b.s:
Consider the following statements about Indian coal:
1. It has high ash content.
2. It has high calorific value.
3. It has low sulphur content.
Which of the above statements are correct?
n44c6ef8210b.x: Indian coal generally has high ash, low calorific value, high ash-fusion temperature and low sulphur, so statement 2 is wrong.

n5a90b83e481.s: India imports coking coal mainly from:
n5a90b83e481.x: Coking coal is imported mainly from Australia, whereas non-coking coal comes mainly from Indonesia and South Africa.

n7664482b727.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. LNG is natural gas cooled below −160°C.
2. CNG is natural gas compressed to about 200–250 kg/cm².
3. LPG mainly contains methane.
Which of the above statements are correct?
n7664482b727.x: LNG is cooled below −160°C and CNG is compressed to about 200–250 kg/cm²; LPG mainly contains propane and butane, not methane.

n9edad36ecb1.s:
After the Strait of Hormuz closure in March 2026, India reportedly:
1. Leaned more on domestic coal and gas.
2. Accelerated LNG and LPG imports.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n9edad36ecb1.x: The Hormuz closure led India to lean on domestic coal and gas and to accelerate LNG and LPG imports.

nbf543f19118.s: Which of the following product – main use pairs is correctly matched?
nbf543f19118.x: Naphtha is used for petrochemicals and fertilisers; LPG for household cooking, CNG for vehicles and furnace oil in industrial boilers.

n91f6744f945.s:
Arrange in chronological order:
1. Nationalisation of non-coking coal
2. Establishment of Coal India Ltd
3. Nationalisation of coking coal
n91f6744f945.x: Coking coal was nationalised in 1971-72, non-coking coal in 1973, and Coal India Ltd was set up in 1975.

nb2c09ed41da.s: Oil formation is chiefly associated with which geological period?
nb2c09ed41da.x: The Tertiary period is the period of oil formation, and most reserves occur in anticlines and fault traps.

n3e2e7c841d2.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Conventional gas occurs only in impermeable shale.
2. Unconventional gas occurs in impermeable sandstone, shale or coal seams and needs costly extraction technology.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n3e2e7c841d2.x: Conventional gas is generally found in permeable sandstone, so 1 is wrong; unconventional gas occurs in impermeable sandstone, shale or coal seams and needs costly technology.
